one_line: Committed CSV and Parquet files daio_2019.csv through daio_2026.csv: daily departures, arrivals, internal and overflight counts by EUROCONTROL member state, 2019 to present, auto-updated.
abnb_use: A daily, current-through-2026 European air-traffic series by country — a fresh EMEA travel-volume nowcast input for 3Q26/4Q26 nights that leads Eurostat's ~150-day-lagged platform nights by months.
sample_plan: raw.githubusercontent pull of daio_2025.csv and daio_2026.csv (country x day, a few thousand rows each, well under 5 MB); check for a LICENSE file in the same pull.
